description: Defines the ClientSocketHandle class, which manages a StreamSocket connection, including initialization, priority, error handling, and socket reuse within the net namespace.

classes.name: ClientSocketHandle
classes.description: Manages a network socket connection, including initialization, priority, error states, and socket reuse within the net namespace.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the handle by obtaining a connected socket from the pool, possibly reusing an existing one. Returns OK or ERR_IO_PENDING.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of the socket connection request.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the handle to an uninitialized state, releasing the socket.

methods.name: ResetAndCloseSocket
methods.description: Resets the handle and closes the socket, cancelling ongoing connection attempts.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the socket.

methods.name: IsPoolStalled
methods.description: Checks if the socket pool is stalled.

methods.name: AddHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Adds a higher layered pool on top of the current socket pool.

methods.name: RemoveHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Removes a previously added higher layered pool.

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets in the same group.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves timing info related to connection establishment.

methods.name: SetSocket
methods.description: Assigns a new socket to the handle.

methods.name: SetAdditionalErrorState
methods.description: Populates error info from a failed connect attempt.

methods.name: PassSocket
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the socket to the caller.
